campaign.unsupportedReason: Campaign metrics are only available from a completed marketing review: the platform has no standalone metrics store, and no review has yet produced a readable digest. Campaigns may well exist at the provider — this is "cannot say", not "none".

knownGaps.reason: The editor reports a finished master as an absolute path on the operator machine. No shareable media reference (object storage path or equivalent) exists yet, so a render can be reported as finished but not played back from another system.
No thumbnail is produced or recorded by the render pipeline.
The job result records total pipeline time, not the duration of the rendered video. Projecting it as a video duration would be wrong, so it is omitted.

The platform has no standalone metrics store. Campaign numbers exist only as the digest embedded in the most recent marketing.recommendation artifact, so this reflects what one review examined rather than a continuous series.
The live Insights adapter has not had its spend currency unit verified against the real account, so no monetary campaign figure is projected.
Delivery state is derived from the effect ledger fold. The ledger records a provider id on CONFIRMED but no permalink, so a published post cannot be linked to from here.
Editor-side model and speech spend is invisible to the platform budget: the job result usage map is defined by the contract but is always empty in spec v1.
